name: Shippingport Lateral Project

values.PipelineName: National Fuel Gas Supply Corporation Gas Pipeline
values.StartLocation: Line N tie-in, Independence Township, Beaver County

researcher_notes: A National Fuel notice filed with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission in August 2025 describes 7.26 miles of 24-inch pipe, 205,000 dekatherms per day and a cost of $57.3 million, from Line N to the Shippingport Power Station. The August 2026 release of the Energy Information Administration pipeline projects workbook (sheet Natural Gas Pipeline Projects, row 109) states the same figures and lists the status as Applied, but the Data Center Frontier article says the line entered construction in 2026 (the National Fuel project page was not readable for this detail), so status is construction. Target in service is late 2026. Data center tie: a Data Center Frontier article from 2026 says National Fuel disclosed that this lateral serves demand tied to a behind-the-meter data center at the Shippingport site. The EIA and Federal Register entries name power demand only. A July 2025 Rigzone article says the plant developer has a partner for a collocated data center. No source found names the data center company as the lateral's shipper, so DataCenter is yes on the strength of the trade article and the company disclosure it reports. National Fuel pipeline name matches the existing roster spelling. This is a separate project from the Main Line row and has its own row. Route not researched; no route yet. Start year 2026 is the planned in-service year. Some sources round the length to 7.5 miles.
